notes.title: Cloud saves now available!
notes.notes:
Yes, I know, I know. We should have implemented this a very long time ago. But with IOAWN4T being such a short game that can be completed in a single play session or two, we didn't think it was necessary and simply moved on to other things.

Now that more and more people are playing on their Steam Deck, however, we thought this could be a nice feature to have for those of you who like to switch between your main PC / laptop and your handheld, so there you go!

Hope you enjoy this tiny update, and a belated happy new year to everybody!

Laura & Thomas

notes.title: In just 2 hours, If On a Winter's Night, Four Travelers tells one of the best adventure game stories I've ever played
notes.notes: One of my favorite games of 2021 was completely and utterly free, took five minutes to install, and less than 2 hours to finish even when I purposefully took my time walking around and clicking on everything a dozen times. And yet it was one of the most enriching story-driven experiences I’ve had the pleasure of playing, wrapped up in a point-and-click adventure of remarkable depth. I’m talking about If On A Winter’s Night… Four Travelers made by Laura Hunt and Thomas Möhring under the banner of Dead Idle Games... Read more.
